description: Get market-ranked token rows, optionally scoped to one chain (chain=solana, base, ...), with market cap, volume, price and market-cap change, circulating supply, ATH and ATL history, nullable FDV/MCap, the home chain (chainSlug, what chain filters on) plus every supported chain the asset is deployed on including bridged copies (chainSlugs), observed exchange availability, quote freshness, and enrichment coverage. Delisted or halted markets whose upstream quote is over 24 hours old are excluded rather than reporting a weeks-old price change as current. Ambiguous same-ticker assets do not receive symbol-only exchange attribution. No wallet signal or proprietary score is returned.

chain.description: Keep only assets whose home chain (chainSlug) is this chain. A token bridged to the chain (chainSlugs) does not match: Chainlink is an Ethereum asset, not a Solana one. A chain's own coin is homed on that chain (SOL under solana, BNB under bsc); a coin or token whose home chain is unsupported (BTC, ICP) matches none. An unknown chain is a 400.

cursor.description: Opaque, snapshot-bound pagination cursor from a previous response. Cursors expire when the cache refreshes; restart without a cursor after an expiry error.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return per page.

name: get_gem_finder

athDate.description: ISO 8601 time of the all-time high, as CoinGecko sends it. An empty string when CoinGecko sends none.

chainSlug.description: Home chain: CoinGecko's primary asset platform, or the chain itself for a chain's own coin (SOL, BNB, POL), contract or not. The chain filter matches this. Null when the home is not a supported chain, even if the asset is bridged to one.

chainSlugs.description: The home chain (chainSlug, when set) first, then every other supported chain with a contract for the asset (bridged deployments), in priority order. An empty array means no supported chain is known.

fromAth.description: The price against the all-time high, as a fraction, 0 or below (-0.4587 is 45.87% under the ATH).

fromAtl.description: The price against the all-time low, as a fraction, 0 or above (10.05 is 1,005% over the ATL).

lastUpdated.description: CoinGecko quote timestamp. Assets whose quote is older than 24 hours are excluded as no-longer-trading; a null value means the upstream omitted the field.

marketCapReturn24h.description: 24-hour market cap change, as a fraction (-0.0731 is -7.31%).

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.
